what: End-to-end runs of the whole system on real recorded speech: the team's own recorded English test visit (a scripted, made-up patient), played into the real Tákàdá app as the microphone, drafted by the shipped stack (N-ATLaS ASR int8 -> fine-tuned N-ATLaS 8B Q4 -> checks -> rules).
